title.narrative: Nicaragua joined together for a sustainable national response in the reduction of tuberculosis and mortality with emphasis on vulnerable populations and based on family and community health model - Nicaragua (01-Jul-2019-31-Dec-2021)

description.narrative: Nicaragua, Tuberculosis, World Vision International (WVI Nicaragua)This program has the following goals: Reduce the TB burden at 25% by 2020 // Reducir la Carga de TB en 25% al 2020. Reduce the TB mortality rate in 35% by 2020 // Reducir la mortalidad de TB en 35% al 2020. The objectives of this program are: Contribute to the prevention and integrated TB care focusing on people affected by Tuberculosis // Contribuir en la prevención y la atención integrada de la TB centrada en personas afectadas por Tuberculosis. Strengthen the political commitment , the capacity of the National Program , communities , social organizations, public and private providers in prevention, care and TB control // Fortalecer el compromiso político, la capacidad del Programa Nacional, las comunidades, organizaciones sociales y proveedores público privados en la prevención, atención y control de la TB. Contribute to operational, epidemiological and clinical research, implementation of initiatives and new technologies of rapid diagnostics for tuberculosis control // Contribuir con la investigación operativa, epidemiológica y clínica, implementación de iniciativas y nuevas tecnologías de diagnósticos rápidos para el control de la tuberculosis
